text_sanskrit: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः । छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ॥ ४-४२ ॥
itrans: tasmAdaj~nAnasambhUtaM hR^itstha.n j~nAnAsinAtmanaH . ChittvainaM sa.nshayaM yogamAtiShThottiShTha bhArata .. 4-42 ..
translation:
Therefore, having cut asunder with the sword of wisdom this doubt that has arisen out of ignorance and abides in the heart, follow the Yoga, do thou stand up, O Bharata.
V. Therefore: the results of observing or neglecting the means of knowledge, being productive of different consequences as explained above yoga: the means of wisdom which is the discharging of duties.
